title: 9th MEB general unloading completed
placementNote: Pre-July predecessor/background material; chapter coverage must be deliberately decided before publication.

paragraphs.text: General unloading of the 9th MEB was completed on March 12. After a March 8–9 firefight between VC and Vietnamese troops north of RED Beach, the amphibious ships shifted anchorage toward the Song Han mouth; unloading then continued upriver. This is brigade-level logistical context, not a claim that each 3/9 company remained aboard until March 12.

notes: Source references support the whole proposal; normalized OCR is not a human correction.
